status_label: Account creation open — 2026/2027 loan window not yet announced
note: NELFUND account creation is currently open and has no announced deadline, so you can create your account and sort out your BVN. Any deadline you may be seeing relates to the previous loan/upkeep application cycle, which has already closed. The 2026/2027 loan and upkeep application window is expected to open soon, but NELFUND has not yet announced the official opening or closing date. Always confirm on portal.nelf.gov.ng. Do not rely on social media for deadlines.
